## Checklist

- [ ] Folder is named `<name>-skill` and `SKILL.md` frontmatter `name` matches it exactly
- [ ] Registered in `skills.json`
- [ ] Ran `npm run docs` and committed the generated READMEs
- [ ] `npm run validate` passes
- [ ] Actually tested it in a real agent and confirmed it triggers
